OCD.name: CloudCat
OCD.description: Copies messages between two Kapua cloud connections, each one on behalf of its own application ID. In a typical scenario, the first cloud connection connects to the cloud platform broker via the default cloud connection. The second one connects to the embedded broker via a second cloud connection instance. An external process, connected to the embedded broker, can optionally subscribe to the topic namespace of the second application i.e. second-account-name/second-device-id/second.cloud.client.app.id/# to receive data messages and $EDC/second-account-name/second-device-id/second.cloud.client.app.id/# to receive control messages where the account name and device ID are configured in the DataTransportService layer of the cloud connection. Messages matching the configured subscriptions will be relayed between the first and second application preserving the application topic, using the QoS of the matching subscription: [$EDC/]first-account-name/first-device-id/first.cloud.client.app.id/app-topic <-> [$EDC/]second-account-name/second-device-id/second.cloud.client.app.id/app-topic.

AD.name: Relay Enable
AD.description: Enable relaying messages between the two cloud connections.

AD.name: First Cloud Connection PID
AD.description: The kura.service.pid of the first Kapua cloud connection, e.g. org.eclipse.kura.cloud.CloudService.

AD.name: Second Cloud Connection PID
AD.description: The kura.service.pid of the second Kapua cloud connection, e.g. org.eclipse.kura.cloud.CloudService-2.

AD.name: First App ID
AD.description: The application identifier used on the first cloud connection.

AD.name: Second App ID
AD.description: The application identifier used on the second cloud connection.

AD.name: First Control Subscriptions
AD.description: Comma-separated list of control subscriptions on the first cloud connection, each in the form control-app-topic;Qos. Only the control messages matching these subscriptions are relayed.

AD.name: Second Control Subscriptions
AD.description: Comma-separated list of control subscriptions on the second cloud connection, each in the form control-app-topic;Qos. Only the control messages matching these subscriptions are relayed.

AD.name: First Data Subscriptions
AD.description: Comma-separated list of data subscriptions on the first cloud connection, each in the form data-app-topic;Qos. Usually not needed.

AD.name: Second Data Subscriptions
AD.description: Comma-separated list of data subscriptions on the second cloud connection, each in the form data-app-topic;Qos.
